newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Piltel says signs cooperation pact.
newsitem.headline: Piltel says signs cooperation pact.

text.p: Pilipino Telephone Corp (Piltel) said on Wednesday it has signed a cooperation agreement with local firm Major Telecommunications Inc for the development of a phone network in the southern Mindanao island.
Piltel and Major Telecommunications have been mandated by the Philippine National Telecommunications Commission (NTC) to operate telephone networks in contiguous areas in Mindanao.

"Cognisant of the mutual benefit derived from economies of scale and scope from pooled consolidated operating platforms, the companies seek to explore and pursue the initiatives to gain this mutual benefit through this memorandum of understanding," Piltel said.

It said both firms agreed to form a committee, with a representative each from Piltel and Major Telecommunications, to explore the possibility of an "operating alliance" on services, infrastructure and facilities, business and market development, administration, engineering and technology.
Major Telecommunications is a unit of international phone gateway operator Philippine Global Communications Inc.
